metaTitle: Baby Care Services in Chennai | Nannies & Babysitters | {{name}}
metaDescription: Reliable baby care and nanny services in Chennai, Thoraipakkam, and OMR. Loving, attentive babysitters for toddlers, developmental playtime, feeding, and daily supervision.
eyebrowText: Baby Care · Toddlers & Young Children · OMR & Chennai
heroSubtitle: A caretaker your toddler actually likes — meals eaten, naps taken, no screen spiral — while you're at work or asleep. Message your child's age and your area; you'll hear back today.
whoIsItFor: Maternity leave ended last week and the daycare waitlist says three months.
Your 2-year-old is faster than the furniture, and someone needs to watch him every second.
You work from home but can't take a call without being climbed on.
School starts at 8, office at 9:30 — the 3pm pickup needs someone reliable.
availableWorkers: The caretakers you'll meet are used to high-energy children: feeding a stubborn eater without a fight, keeping a toddler out of the balcony's reach, walking to the school gate and back. They follow your parenting rules — screen time, sweets, discipline — not their own. Each profile shows their experience with children your child's age.
scopeIncluded: Constant supervision — safe play zones, childproofed rooms, no unattended balconies or staircases
Patient feeding: meals, fruits, snacks, and water reminders for a child who forgets to drink
Diaper changes, toilet-training support, handwashing and daily baths
Real play — blocks, books, rhymes, drawing, walks in the apartment park
Preschool prep: tiffin packed, uniform ready, school van or bus stop escort
Nap routines — bed at the same hour, without a battle
Tidying play areas and washing the child's clothes and dining items
scopeExcluded: Discipline, schooling and medical decisions — those stay with the parents
Homework tutoring beyond simple reading practice, unless agreed
Driving the family car for school runs — say it upfront if you need this

localCoverage: Baby care across Okkiyam Thoraipakkam, Perungudi, Sholinganallur, Karapakkam, OMR, Adyar, Velachery, Semmancheri and South Chennai — full-day and live-in both common along the corridor.
disclaimer: Baby care workers provide domestic childcare and supervision within the home. Parents maintain responsibility for overarching discipline, educational curriculum, and medical healthcare decisions.

unaskedQAs.question: What age can she start from?
unaskedQAs.answer: From about six months through toddlerhood to early school age. Tell us your child's exact age — the fit for an 8-month-old and a 4-year-old is completely different.

unaskedQAs.question: Will she just put my child in front of the TV?
unaskedQAs.answer: Screen rules are yours. Write them into the agreement — many families set no screens before nap; caretakers follow the household's rule when it's stated clearly.

unaskedQAs.question: Can she cook the child's meals?
unaskedQAs.answer: Simple child meals — khichdi, porridge, eggs, fruit purees, milk — yes. Cooking for the whole family is a separate scope; agree the split before she starts.

unaskedQAs.question: How do I know she won't leave my child alone in the flat?
unaskedQAs.answer: Never leaving a young child unattended is a plain instruction given at placement — near balconies, kitchens, water and stairs. You also get her references, which you're welcome to check.

unaskedQAs.question: My child is shy with strangers — can she come for a trial visit?
unaskedQAs.answer: Introductions happen before you decide. Bring her once on a weekend afternoon; your child's comfort on that day tells you more than any profile.

unaskedQAs.question: What about the 3pm school pickup?
unaskedQAs.answer: School van and bus stop escort is part of full-day shifts. Tell us the school, the timing and the route in the first message — that's what determines who's actually available.

unaskedQAs.question: What do you need from us in the first message?
unaskedQAs.answer: Your child's age, your locality, full-day or part-time, and the school timing if there is one. Add anything unusual — allergies, a grandparent at home — and we'll match accordingly.

faqs.question: At what age can a baby care helper start looking after my child?
faqs.answer: From around six months, once the baby can hold their head steadily, through toddlerhood and into the early school years. Profiles specify the ages each caretaker has actually handled.

faqs.question: Can the babysitter engage my child in non-screen activities?
faqs.answer: Yes — blocks, storybooks, rhymes, drawing and outdoor walks. If your house has a no-screen rule, state it on day one and it becomes part of her instructions.

faqs.question: How do you ensure child safety?
faqs.answer: Identity is verified, previous families are called as references, and caretakers are told plainly: never leave a young child alone near balconies, kitchens, water or open windows. You meet her before she starts.

faqs.question: Can the caretaker prepare simple meals for the toddler?
faqs.answer: Yes — khichdi, porridge, boiled eggs, fruit purees, milk and similar child meals. If you need the whole family's cooking too, that's a cooking shift and should be agreed as one.

faqs.question: Are live-in child caretakers available in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Yes — live-in nannies stay in your home with structured rest hours, alongside full-day 8-to-12-hour options. Night expectations are written down before she starts.
